title: Lines
description: Line-level domain shapes of a [[Change]]: consecutive numbered lines, line ranges, removed lines with their text at the base, and file side

NumberedLines.description: Consecutive lines, each under its number, the first line of a file being 1

Side.description: Which numbering the lines use: head for the file at the head commit, base for the file at the base

LineNumber.description: A line of a file, by its 1-based number

LineNumberName.description: A line number as the name of a property: a whole number from 1

LineText.description: One line of a file, without its line break

LineRange.description: Consecutive lines of one file, by their 1-based numbers, both ends included

RemovedContent.description: The text of removed lines as they stood at the base, one line of text per line removed

RemovedLines.description: Consecutive lines the [[Change]] removes, with their text

ChangedFile.description: One file touched at the [[Head commit]]: the line ranges added on the right (head) and the lines removed on the left (base) with their text
